title: Long-term Keto - Qualitative and quantitative investigation of a long-term ketogenic diet
summary: The ketogenic diet (KD) is a very low-carbohydrate, high-fat diet that is increasingly being used by healthy adults for weight control, performance enhancement, or health benefits. While numerous short-term studies have investigated effects on body weight, blood sugar, and blood lipids, there is a lack of systematic data on the long-term effects of a ketogenic diet practiced independently. Furthermore, it is unclear to what extent knowledge, motivation, and possible side effects correlate with objective measures. This study aims to close this gap with the goal of evaluating the practical relevance and sustainability of the ketogenic diet in the everyday lives of healthy adults. To this end, the dietary behavior, nutritional knowledge, and motivations for following ketogenic diets among adults in Germany will be surveyed. The analyses will be supplemented by measuring metabolic markers and nutritional status using anthropometric measurements.
conditions: No illness/health problem is being investigated. Investigation of dietary behavior, nutritional knowledge, and motivations for following ketogenic diets, as well as determination of metabolic markers and nutritional status in healthy adults in Germany who have been following a ketogenic diet for at least 6 months.

interventions.name: Online survey followed by tests at the study center (24-hour recall, anthropometric data, blood pressure, BIA, indirect calorimetry, ultrasound, capillary blood); further capillary blood and sensor measurements at home and second 24-hour recall

Online survey followed by self-measurement of anthropometric data (body weight/height, waist/hip circumference) and 2x24-hour recall; optional capillary blood measurements at home and additional optional measurements by external providers (blood pressure, BIA, indirect calorimetry, ultrasound)

criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
BMI 18.5–29.9 kg/m2
Regardless of gender
Resident in Germany
Following a ketogenic diet for at least 6 months (self-reported)
Sufficient knowledge of the German language to complete the questionnaires and nutritional assessment methods
Exclusion criteria:
No consent given to participate in the study
Minor age
Pregnancy, breastfeeding
Presence of a serious illness or acute illness at the time of examination (during examination at the study center)
Diagnosed metabolic disorder or epilepsy, or use of a ketogenic diet required for nutritional therapy
